cases.prompt: Generate a TypeScript SDK for our API: GET /projects, POST /projects, GET /projects/{id}. Auth is a bearer token.
expectations: Has a base client holding the base URL and bearer token.
Has a projects resource with list, create and get methods typed with interfaces.
Defines typed error classes for HTTP failures (for example NotFound, Unauthorized).

cases.prompt: Generate a Python client for a cursor-paginated GET /items endpoint (response has items and next_cursor).
expectations: Provides an iterator or generator that follows next_cursor until it is empty.
Sets request timeouts and raises typed exceptions on errors.
Keeps the HTTP session in a reusable client object.
